9:62.text: They swear by Allâh to you
in order to please you, but it is more fitting that they should please Allâh and His Messenger

9:63.text: Know they not that whoever opposes and shows hostility to Allâh
, certainly for him will be the Fire of Hell to abide therein. That is the extreme disgrace.

9:64.text: The hypocrites fear lest a Sûrah
should be revealed about them, showing them what is in their hearts. Say: "
mock! But certainly Allâh will bring to light all that you fear."

9:65.text: , they declare: "We were only talking idly and joking." Say: "Was it at Allâh

9:66.text: Make no excuse; you disbelieved after you had believed. If We pardon some of you, We will punish others amongst you because they were Mujrimûn

9:67.text: The hypocrites, men and women, are one from another; they enjoin
(i.e. disbelief and polytheism of all kinds and all that Islâm has forbidden)
(i.e. Islâmic Monotheism and all that Islâm orders one to do)
. They have forgotten Allâh, so He has forgotten them. Verily, the hypocrites are the Fâsiqûn

9:68.text: Allâh has promised the hypocrites - men and women - and the disbelievers, the Fire of Hell; therein shall they abide. It will suffice them. Allâh has cursed them and for them is the lasting torment.
